# Default catalog reference

[Composition guide](components.md) · [Shared schema](../src/nyx.schema.pas)

Generated by `tools/nyx_catalog_reference.lpr` from the public catalog and schema.
Empty defaults clear optional fields; unknown extension properties are preserved.
Named paths work with `Part` and reusable `OverridePart`; `.` addresses the root.

Capabilities describe current projections, not complete production behavior.
Property Meaning separates shared contract metadata from presentation and interaction.
Unavailable means the standard projection does not enact that property; portable data is retained.
Custom requires a supplied implementation. Studio hints and semantic MCP queries use the same support.
Basic support has family gaps; Text fallback uses a text field. Recipe behavior
and broader accessibility/parity limits are recorded in the composition guide.

Page/definition roots are ordinary nodes. Reusable references own explicit
override descriptors, with definition-provided defaults and independent payloads.

## table — Table

Family: Data. Base projection: `table`.

Display records in rows and columns. Bound browser tables use one Tab entry; F2 or Enter enters a cell editor, Tab traverses editors and Escape returns to row navigation. Native tables use LCL cell editing.

Palette group: Data.
Search labels: Records.
